Version 1.0.1 of showstart-bot

- No file changes detected in this release.
- No user-facing updates or modifications.

Initial release of the showstart skill.

- Enables querying and managing event information from the Showstart platform.
- Supports searching by keyword, city (with fuzzy matching), category, style, artist/venue, and nearby location (latitude/longitude).
- Provides both Python API and command-line interface usage examples.
- Implements request limits, result caching, and pagination.
- Includes error handling and documentation references.
